newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks close 0.33 pct down before holiday.
newsitem.headline: French stocks close 0.33 pct down before holiday.

text.p: French shares closed 0.33 percent lower on Wednesday in a directionless market which was affected just before the close by a lower opening on Wall Street and an easier dollar, dealers said.

Brokers noted many investors squaring their positions as they prepared a long weekend break on the back of the Ascension day holiday on Thursday, amid some uncertainty about pending opinion polls for the May 25/June 1 parliamentary election.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 8.62 points or 0.33 percent at 2,643.31 while the CAC-40 futures contract was down 12.5 points at 2,624.5.
Volume totalled a moderate 6.26 billion francs.

* Shares in Saint-Gobain rose 0.9 percent to 789 francs. Analysts said the company was bullish in a conference call following the release of its Q1 sales, up 31 percent. They said they were pleased to hear it raised flat glass prices last month and intended to raise them again this year.

* Casino shares fell 1.27 percent to 272 francs after the removal of management board chairman Georges Plassat. His departure elicited mixed reactions but the market still views Casino as a merger candidate, brokers said.

* Renault fell 1.63 percent to 138.70 francs, losing its early gains after an appeals court ruled it should have convened its European Group works council to discuss the Vilvoorde plant closure. Renault said it will convene the works council this month and could still close the plant by July 31.
* Lagardere, down 2.22 percent at 176 francs, and Alcatel Alsthom, down 0.92 percent at 647 francs, said they have submitted firm and final bids for Thomson-CSF by the midday deadline on Wednesday.
